outlook.summary: Not financial advice — this is a personal tracking dashboard meant to organize publicly available information for research purposes. Always size positions and confirm with your own research.

strongest.area: Memory and lithography-adjacent chips, led by Micron and ASML
strongest.reason: both extended sharp gains as AI-driven memory and advanced-packaging demand optimism continued to reassert itself, building on the reversal that began earlier in the week

strongest.area: Cybersecurity, led by CrowdStrike, Zscaler, and Unity Software
strongest.reason: cybersecurity names are holding near record highs after last week's Black Hat conference spotlighted rising AI-driven threats, while Unity continues to digest a strong Q2 report

weakest.area: Enterprise AI software, led by Adobe, Salesforce, Palantir, and ServiceNow
weakest.reason: all four fell 2-4% today in a broad-based risk-off move, extending a multi-month selloff tied to fears that AI-native competitors could erode subscription pricing power

weakest.area: Alphabet within the AI infrastructure group
weakest.reason: shares dropped sharply again as markets continue digesting the recently reported leadership shakeup in its AI division

outlook.nextStep: The broad-based pullback across enterprise AI software names today is worth a closer look for whether it reflects a genuine repricing of AI-disruption risk or a one-day risk-off move ahead of Wednesday's CPI report. The memory-and-lithography rally in Micron and ASML is probably better watched for confirmation over the next few sessions than acted on now, given how sharply it has moved in a short window.

signals.title: Markets brace for Wednesday's CPI report as Fed hold odds stay elevated
signals.body: Economists expect Wednesday's CPI report to show headline inflation easing toward the mid-3% range with core inflation cooling modestly, following a prior reading that came in at 2.5% year-on-year. The Fed remains widely expected to hold rates steady at its next meeting, though the decision is described as a close call with a meaningful probability still assigned to alternative outcomes.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how the actual print compares to expectations, since a surprise either direction could move the rate path quickly

signals.title: Memory and lithography names extend their sharp reversal
signals.body: Micron and ASML both posted strong gains again, continuing to unwind the oversupply-driven pressure that weighed on memory and equipment names over the past month. Separately, Intel's $15 billion common stock offering to fund AI and foundry investment continues to draw scrutiny from investors weighing dilution against the capital need.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether this rally has legs or represents a short-term snapback

signals.title: Broad-based selloff hits enterprise AI software names
signals.body: Adobe, Salesforce, Palantir, and ServiceNow all fell 2-4% today, extending a months-long selloff driven by fears that AI-native competitors could disrupt subscription-based pricing power across the sector. Several firms have downgraded these names since mid-year, citing the same underlying concern.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at whether any of these names are separating fundamentals from sentiment, since the move today was broad rather than company-specific

signals.title: Cybersecurity holds near records after Black Hat spotlighted AI-driven threats
signals.body: CrowdStrike and peers surged to record highs after last week's Black Hat conference, where AI security tools dominated industry conversation. Analysts noted that AI agents have changed the threat landscape in ways that are driving fresh modernization spending across endpoint and cloud security budgets.
signals.focus: worth a closer look given the AI-threat narrative looks like it could keep security budgets insulated even as other software categories get squeezed

signals.title: Component suppliers highlight humanoid robotics as a growth market
signals.body: Suppliers of connectors, sensors, and power-management components have flagged humanoid robotics as an emerging growth market, with one major supplier reporting record quarterly sales up over 50% year-on-year. Tesla's Fremont plant conversion toward Optimus production continues, alongside a broader rally in robotics-adjacent names.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at how much of the current run is tied to actual production ramp versus anticipatory positioning

signals.title: SEC set to vote on first major crypto rulemaking Friday
signals.body: The SEC has scheduled an open meeting for Friday to vote on proposed rules creating a tailored offering regime for certain crypto-asset investment contracts, the first formal crypto rulemaking under the current SEC chair. Separately, the Senate has postponed a vote on broader digital-asset market-structure legislation until September.
signals.focus: worth a closer look at Friday's vote outcome, though the broader legislative timeline continues to slip
